anchor: Cities sec 6 founder revision + Wave 1 expansion 2026-05-26. Per-country business formation costs by legal tier for non-financial SMBs (under 250 employees, EU SME definition). Global category names first (Freelancer, Sole Trader, LLC, Joint-Stock); local term in parentheses where the country uses a distinct name. Cost figures in USD-equivalent of mandatory government and notary fees (no professional fees on top). setup_days is a typical online filing turnaround for the registered office. complexity_score is 1 to 5 where 1 is a 15-minute online filing and 5 is lawyer plus notary plus multiple agency visits plus multi-week wait. Excludes wealth-fund and hedge-fund vehicles (Cayman, BVI, Bermuda, SOPARFI, ETVE, VCC, ICAV, fund limited partnerships, trusts, holding-only entities) per founder direction. Sources for the original 40-country block (v1.1.0): government registries (gov.uk, service-public.fr, IHK, MISE, KvK, ASIC, USPTO state filings, Receita Federal, SAT, MCA, ROCs), Chambers of Commerce, and the World Bank Doing Business archive 2003 to 2019. Sources for the v1.2.0 100-country expansion: B-Ready 2024 (the World Bank successor), Doing Business archive 2019, national investment promotion agencies (CAC NG, eCitizen KE, CIPC ZA, GAFI EG, RGD GH, RDB RW, MISA SA, GIPC GH, etc.), and OHADA Uniform Act on Commercial Companies for the francophone African bloc. Formation regimes change slowly; numbers are accurate within typical year-to-year variance for almost all countries. No vintage badge surfaces on the country page (per founder direction 2026-05-26).

tier_definitions.Freelancer: Self-employed without a separate legal entity. Personal income tax applies. Personal liability is unlimited. Often a simplified tax regime is available.
tier_definitions.Sole Trader: Registered personal business name with the commercial registry; required above a revenue threshold in some countries. Personal liability is still unlimited unless paired with a limited-liability vehicle.
tier_definitions.LLC: Limited Liability Company. Personal liability shielded; profits flow through or are taxed at corporate rate depending on jurisdiction.
tier_definitions.Joint-Stock: Stock-issuing company with separate legal personality. Heavier reporting; typical for businesses planning to raise capital or already operating at the upper SMB end.

complexity_legend.1: Online filing in under an hour, no notary, no capital, no in-person visit.
complexity_legend.2: Online filing in a day, minor documentation, no notary required.
complexity_legend.3: Multi-step process, registered office and tax registration required, can finish in a week or two.
complexity_legend.4: Notary or court involvement, minimum capital, signed articles, expect three to six weeks.
complexity_legend.5: Lawyer plus notary plus multiple agency visits, capital deposit, multi-week wait, often two months or more.
